coverage.summary: Applies to rental dwelling units offered for rent by housing providers for residential purposes, except units in owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
coverage.owner_conditions: Dwelling units in owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units are excluded.

result.notes: The existing coverage is supported by the statutory definition of 'rental dwelling unit' in C.46:8-54. I set requires_unknown_facts to false because the act covers ordinary rental dwelling units generally. The only coverage exemption, owner-occupied premises of four or fewer units, is captured by owner_occupied_exemption_max_units. The documents contain no construction-date, unit-count minimum, landlord-size or preemption provisions for this act, so those fields remain null.
